items.title: Loretta Rowland Evans Interview
items.q: Have you ever heard Louis Armstrong play? Oh, he played.

ctx.x: It's kind of like a square dance in a way, they have a call for that.

I believe the end of ragtime came around 1910. They played ragtime so much and beat it so much that it really ended. And 1917 was when the original jazz band started playing. But I don't know, we didn't seem to like that. I thought it was still ragtime. But everyone said that the jazz age was in the 1920s, and in them days, Armstrong wasn't heard of it. And he really can play jazz. Have you ever heard Louis Armstrong play? Oh, he played.
Yeah, I think we both heard he played a few times.
